kanji.story: A person rests beside a tree.
Keep a private mark beside the grain plant: this belongs to me.
A field of ideas sits above the heart when you think.
An eye on moving legs goes out to see.
A person makes a big, energetic mark when saying ‘I’.
A cow beside a sweeping mark points to a tangible thing.
Two stepping shapes make a crossroads: a place to go.
A person asks what can be done: what?
A blade divides something into eight spreading parts.
Put an ear at the gate to hear what is outside.
Words from the mouth fly straight like an arrow when you know.
A refined figure beside a head shows the face.
The sun rises between cross-shaped plants while the moon fades: morning.
An elder pauses over a bent breath while considering an idea.
Steps lead toward the person on the other side.
Words and a tongue come together in talk.
A line marks the root of a tree: the origin and a book’s basis.
Small rays meet a hand: the right thing hits its mark.
Take measured steps by a temple while you wait.
Grass and generations grow on a tree as leaves.
A hand stays steady like a temple while holding something.
Power working in a field forms the traditional image of a man.
A person directs an official to use something.
A person beside the servant component marks the humble masculine ‘I’.
A guiding hand above a mouth addresses you.
Sunlight shines through a gate’s gap: the space between.
Inside one enclosure, one voice says the same thing.
A standing voice beside a village marks one section or department.
A roof-like body covers the place you arrive: a building.
A distorted shape pressing on the heart feels bad.
A sun beside a temple measures time.
A person suddenly gets to work and makes something.
A pig safely under a roof evokes a traditional home.
Everything reaches the heart as a feeling.
A bow, a tight private knot and an insect combine into strength.
Bamboo bends like a lively person laughing.
Evening after evening means many nights.
Woman and child form an old image of affection and liking.
A field divided between sections creates a boundary or world.
An eye examines a tree and meets its counterpart.
The next pose of a person reveals their appearance.
Remains beside a seated figure mark death.
A net settles straight over something placed in position.
Sunlight rises over earth to reveal a place or grounds.
An axe works by a door at a particular place.
A mountain rises out of an open container: to go out.
A vessel beside the head component points to the head.
A large figure turns through a door to return.
A mouth sends out breath to call.
A thread keeps running beside the sell component: continue.
People gather under shared words to meet.
A covered central figure marks something important and necessary.
A thread reaches winter and comes to its end.
An elder under the sun represents a person who acts.
Power shifts something heavy, making it move.
Small steps follow a short thread from behind: after.
An opening inside an enclosure faces a direction.
Crossing energy moves through the air as spirit or feeling.
A following foot alters what was there: change.
Movement around a boundary takes a different path.
Words point toward an unknown bird-like figure: who?
A person lacking breath pauses before what comes next.
A person serves as a skilled worker.
A person steps onto a platform to begin.
Something stands above the sun-like mark as a clear sound.
A person’s root and basis is the body.
A hand places a marked object so it hangs.
Careful learning plus action becomes teaching.
A stopping foot moves a little at a time: walk.
A sound held in the heart becomes meaning or intention.
The mouth explores a flavour not yet known.
Arrange a wine vessel for oneself: distribute or prepare.
A tree, sheep and flowing mark build a distinctive appearance or manner.
At evening, call from the mouth so people know the name.
A child under a supporting cross exists and is cared for.
A supporting cross planted in earth marks being present.
Movement winds past an enclosed opening: pass by.
A hand from above passes something through a cover to another hand: receive.
Crossed action, wood and a tool form a severe striking image.
Legs move out from beneath the top shape and go ahead first.
A coloured thread is cut off completely: absolute or severed.
A measured hand answers a written pattern: opposite or versus.
Trust the words spoken by a person: believe.
Polished jade follows the lines of a village: reason and order.
At evening, a divination mark points beyond the home: outside.
Movement follows an omen away from danger: escape.
Something is lost from the heart: forget.
A person beside ‘also’ means another person or other.
A mouth at the gate asks a question.
A correct statement beside a page becomes a topic or problem.
A hand measures beneath a roof: degree or occasion.
Things lined up under the sun are general and widespread.
Movement follows an open path: pass through.
Under the sun, a hand takes what the ear noticed: the most.
The first step in making clothes is cutting fabric with a blade.
A measuring hand beneath a roof guards the home.
The body component beside an enclosing shape marks the chest.
A clear feeling in the heart becomes emotion or circumstance.
Seeds spread across a field in an ordered turn or number.
A valley-like emptiness lacks something and creates desire.
Small rays under a cover open into seeing: awaken or remember.
A blade separates one thing from another.
Sun and moon together make everything bright and clear.
Words, five and a mouth come together as language.
Three trees gather into a forest.
